How this was tested

Historical tests of FTM MACHINE in MetaTrader 5, with all profits reinvested and leverage 1:100. Every trade has a stop loss and is sized from the account balance according to the risk profile.

  • Gold (XAUUSD): 1 January 2020 to 8 October 2026, starting balances from $500 to $1M.
  • Bitcoin (BTCUSD): 1 January 2020 to 16 October 2026 at FundedNext, one-minute price data with the broker's real spread, commission and swap, starting balances from $1k to $100k.
  • USD/JPY (USDJPY): 1 January 2020 to 16 October 2026 at FundedNext, one-minute price data with the broker's real spread, commission and swap, starting balances from $1k to $100k.
  • US Tech 100 (NDX100): 1 November 2022 to 16 October 2026 at FundedNext (all the history the broker has for this market), one-minute price data with the broker's real spread, commission and swap, starting balances $10k and $100k.
  • Boom 1000 (BOOM1000, synthetic index): 1 January 2020 to 16 October 2026 at Deriv, one-minute price data, starting balances $10k and $100k.
  • All in one: every trade from the five tests above replayed in time order on one shared balance with shared margin, 1 January 2020 to 16 October 2026. USD/JPY and Boom 1000 run at half weight; US Tech 100 joins in November 2022, when its broker history starts. Starting balances $10k and $100k.
